name: XPRS 1.11.0
body:
## Archiver

- The Archiver is now part of the app instead of a wapp: open it from the top-left menu. The old Archive wapp is removed on update; its settings carry over.
- A new Impact tab shows what your device gives the network:
  - how many stations rely on it to hold their mail;
  - requests answered and messages delivered in the last 30 days;
  - charts of requests served (14 days) and storage given (30 days);
  - what it keeps (yours, people you follow, strangers);
  - the last 24 hours, and milestones.
- The home screen invites you to become an archiver, and thanks you with your week's numbers once you are one.
- On a phone, the archiver answers under the device's own X3 callsign, not your personal X1 callsign, and signs with the device's key.
- An archiver address you type by hand is kept; it is no longer replaced by the one the archiver announces.
- After being offline, the phone reconnects to its archiver as soon as the internet is back instead of waiting up to ten minutes.

## Look

- A plain black-and-white theme replaces the purple accents.

## Search and groups

- Search finds people, stations and groups by name through the archivers.
- New groups get an X5 callsign.

## Fixes

- A held request, and its answer, is handed over once instead of being sent again and again; archivers send far fewer packets.
